content.thinking: 用户现在说“哈喽呀”，这是一个简单的问候，根据系统提示，如果是简单的问候，应该用简单的回答然后停止。那我直接回复“哈喽😊”就可以了，不需要调用任何工具。

用户让我来问问题，我需要设计几个有趣且合适的问题。首先，考虑到用户可能是在和我互动，我应该选择一些轻松、开放的话题，同时符合工具的要求（1-4个问题，每个问题2-4个选项）。

首先，我可以问关于兴趣爱好的问题，比如喜欢的休闲活动类型。然后，可能问关于技术偏好的问题，比如喜欢的编程语言。还可以问关于学习方式的问题，比如更喜欢自学还是课程。最后，可能问关于未来计划的问题，比如是否有学习新技术的打算。

现在，我需要按照工具的格式来构造这些问题。每个问题需要有header、options、multi_select等参数。确保选项清晰，描述准确。

让我开始设计：

第一个问题：兴趣爱好
header: Hobbies
question: 你平时最喜欢的休闲活动是什么？
options:
- 阅读书籍：沉浸在文字世界，获取知识或乐趣
- 户外运动：享受自然，保持活力
- 电子游戏：在虚拟世界中挑战与放松
- 创意创作：绘画、写作或手工制作
multi_select: false

第二个问题：技术偏好
header: Tech
question: 你最常用或最喜欢的编程语言是？
options:
- Python：简洁易读，适合数据分析和AI
- JavaScript：Web开发必备，全栈能力强
- Java：企业级应用，跨平台稳定
- Go：高性能并发，云原生友好
multi_select: false

第三个问题：学习方式
header: Learning
question: 你更喜欢哪种学习新技术的方式？
options:
- 在线课程：结构化教学，跟随进度学习
- 实战项目：边做边学，解决实际问题
- 文档阅读：直接查阅官方文档，自主探索
- 社区交流：参与论坛或讨论，向他人请教
multi_select: false

第四个问题：未来计划
header: Future
question: 你近期有没有学习新技术的打算？
options:
- 有明确目标：已经选好想学的技术和方向
- 正在考虑：有想法但还没确定具体内容
- 暂时没有：专注于现有技术的深化
- 随缘：遇到合适的机会再学习
multi_select: false

现在，把这些问题整理成工具调用的格式，确保符合要求。

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command in a unix-like environment

description.description: Explain why you want to execute the command. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

tools.name: file_info
tools.description: Return metadata about a file or directory at an absolute path.

description.description: Explain why you want to inspect the path. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories from an absolute path, with optional recursion.

description.description: Explain why you want to inspect the directory. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute directory path to inspect.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

tools.name: glob_search
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern under an absolute directory.

description.description: Explain why you want to find files. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute directory path to search within.

pattern.description: Glob pattern, for example **/*.ts or src/**/*.tsx.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: grep_search
tools.description: Search file contents with ripgrep under an absolute directory.

description.description: Explain why you want to search file contents. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute directory path to search within.

pattern.description: Text or regex pattern to search for.

caseSensitive.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: mkdir
tools.description: Create a directory at an absolute path.

description.description: Explain why you want to create the directory. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute directory path to create.

recursive.description: Whether to create parent directories recursively.

tools.name: move_path
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory between absolute paths.

description.description: Explain why you want to move the path. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from an absolute path. Supports optional line-range reads for large files.

description.description: Explain why you want to read the file. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return from the selected range.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write to a file at an absolute path. Creates parent directories if they do not exist.

description.description: Explain why you want to write to the file. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute path to the file to write to.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

tools.name: str_replace
tools.description: Replace occurrences of a substring in a file. Make sure the `old` is unique in the file.

description.description: Explain why you want to perform this replacement. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

path.description: The absolute path to the file to operate on.

new.description: The substring to be replaced with.

count.description: Maximum number of replacements. Omit to replace all occurrences.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff patch to one or more files using absolute paths in the patch headers. Note: File deletion is not supported (will fail if +++ /dev/null is used).

description.description: Explain why you want to apply the patch. Always place `description` as the first parameter.

patch.description: Unified diff patch content with --- and +++ headers. Must use absolute paths.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description:
Create and manage a structured task list for the current session. This helps track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness.

## When to Use

1. Complex multi-step tasks requiring 3 or more distinct steps
2. Non-trivial tasks requiring careful planning or multiple operations
3. User explicitly requests a todo list
4. User provides multiple tasks (numbered or comma-separated)
5. After receiving new instructions — capture requirements as todos (use merge=false to add new ones)
6. After completing tasks — mark complete with merge=true and add follow-ups
7. When starting new tasks — mark as in_progress (ideally only one at a time)

## When NOT to Use

1. Single, straightforward tasks
2. Trivial tasks with no organizational benefit
3. Tasks completable in fewer than 3 trivial steps
4. Purely conversational or informational requests

## Task States

- pending: Not yet started
- in_progress: Currently working on (limit to ONE at a time)
- completed: Finished successfully
- cancelled: No longer needed

## Task Management Rules

- Update status in real-time as you work
- Mark tasks complete IMMEDIATELY after finishing (don't batch completions)
- Only ONE task should be in_progress at any time
- Complete current tasks before starting new ones
- If blocked, keep the task as in_progress and create a new task for the blocker

## Merge Behavior

- merge=true: Merges by id — existing ids are updated, new ids are appended. You can send only the changed items.
- merge=false: Replaces the entire list with the provided todos.

id.description: Unique identifier for this todo item.

todos.description: Array of todo items to create or update.

merge.description: If true, merges into the existing list by id (existing ids updated, new ids appended). If false, replaces the entire list.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user one or more independent questions with fixed choices. Prefer this over free-form questions when options are clear. Questions are parallel (no dependency between them). You may send 1–4 questions in one call. For each question set multi_select true only when multiple answers make sense.

question.description: Full question text; be specific and end with a question mark where appropriate.

header.description: Very short tab/tag label (max 12 characters), e.g. Auth, Library.

label.description: Short display label for this choice (1–5 words).

description.description: What this choice means or implies.

preview.description: Optional markdown preview when this option is focused (single-select only).

options.description: 2–4 distinct choices; mutually exclusive unless multi_select is true.

multi_select.description: If true, the user may pick multiple options; if false, exactly one.

questions.description: 1–4 parallel, independent questions (no dependency between them).
